title: Q1
description:
Read: Lev 16:29-30, Psa 51:16-17

That day is said to cleanse from all sins. It is also said that God does not desire sacrifice, or it would be given, and that his sacrifice is a broken spirit.

a) The blood of bulls and goats cannot take sins away, and the law is a shadow. How can both older texts stand, without one of them being false?
